text:
maya: Quick Q — can we get a 1-line status for each Q4 OKR milestone (what shipped, what slipped, owner, any blocker deps)? I'll aggregate for the exec note.

sam: Payment API scaling (OKR-3b) — shipped canary yesterday, rolling to prod this morning. Owner: @sam. Dep: none. Observability looks good. :shipit:

tom: Inference autoscaler (OKR-2a) — slipped 1 sprint. Need extra SRE time for the burst policy. Owner: @tom. Dep: eng-infra bandwidth.

aline: Console rollout (OKR-1c) — shipped UI v2, missing role-based settings (deferred). Owner: @aline. Dep: product auth team for RBAC endpoints.

raj: Quantization tooling (OKR-2b) — prototype done, need model QA for 2 models. Owner: @raj. Blocker: model QA slot next week. 

sophia: Dedicated offering docs & pricing (OKR-4) — pricing landed, docs in review. Owner: @sophia. Dep: finance approval for list price.

sam: Quick follow-up — @tom what's ETA to unblock autoscaler? Can we borrow 0.5 FTE from eng-sre for 2 weeks?

tom: I can take that but need decision by EOD. If yes, target is +1 sprint (deliver by 10/18). If no, will slip to 11/1.

maya: Noted. @people-ops to confirm temporary assignment? @tom can you post a short RFC on scope so it's clear?

tom: Yep, will drop RFC in eng-infra channel in ~30m. Snippet:
```
RFC: autoscaler-burst-policy
- scope: scale-up thresholds + KV cache eviction
- req: 0.5 FTE SRE for 2w
- target: 10/18 rollout
```

aline: RBAC dependency — @security, any ETA on the OAuth scopes PR? It's the blocker for role settings.

sophia: Finance assigned review to @michelle, expect sign-off by Fri EOD. If blocked, we can ship docs with TBD pricing flag.

deploy-bot: deploy: payment-api canary -> prod started by @sam at 1775007120. Status: partial, 3/5 regions.

raj: model QA slot confirmed for 10/12. Will update if anything changes.

maya: Great — I'll assemble the update and ping execs. One more ask: please add one test case to the console RBAC story so we can detect regressions early. @aline

aline: will do. Adding to the sprint board now. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll post consolidated note by EOD. If anything changes, reply here.
